questions.cardText:
[Physics] What does it mean if a material is diamagnetic?
A. It is attracted to a magnetic field
B. It weakens external magnetic fields
C. It is repelled by a magnetic field
Answer: C. Diamagnetic materials create an opposing magnetic field when exposed to an external magnetic field, causing them to be repelled. This effect is very weak and is a universal property of all materials, but it is often overshadowed by stronger magnetic behaviors like ferromagnetism and paramagnetism.
questions.de: Wie nennt man einen Stoff, der von einem Magnetfeld schwach abgestoßen wird, weil das Feld in ihm ein entgegengesetztes Feld induziert?
questions.en: What is a material that is weakly repelled by a magnetic field, because the field induces an opposing field inside it, called?

timeline.labelEn: Michael Faraday shows diamagnetism is a property of all matter and names the phenomenon
timeline.labelDe: Michael Faraday zeigt, dass Diamagnetismus eine Eigenschaft aller Materie ist, und benennt das Phänomen

questions.notes: Option B ('weakens external fields') is also loosely true of diamagnets, which is why the question asks for the name instead. First observed by Anton Brugmans in bismuth (1778).

questions.cardText:
[Art History] What is the “auteur theory” in film studies?
A. The director’s personal vision is vital
B. Films should reflect the current political climate
C. Actors should use real emotions
Answer: A.
questions.de: Welche Theorie der Filmkritik, 1962 von Andrew Sarris in den USA populär gemacht, besagt, dass die persönliche Vision des Regisseurs ihn zum eigentlichen Autor eines Films macht?
questions.en: Which theory of film criticism, popularised in the US by Andrew Sarris in 1962, holds that a director's personal vision makes them the true author of a film?

timeline.labelEn: Andrew Sarris's essay 'Notes on the Auteur Theory in 1962' names and popularises the auteur theory in the US
timeline.labelDe: Andrew Sarris' Essay „Notes on the Auteur Theory in 1962“ benennt die Autorentheorie und macht sie in den USA populär

questions.notes: Reversed from 'what is the auteur theory' to ask its name. The idea goes back to French critics (Bazin, Astruc, Truffaut) of the late 1940s–50s; the German name is Autorentheorie (Autorenfilm).
